name: Halo
summary: A download pill that shrinks into a circle whose own outline fills up as the file arrives
about: Halo is a violet download button that turns its outline into a progress ring. A glowing head rides the front of the ring and the percent sits in the middle while a soft glow breathes behind it. At the finish the circle pops, a ripple rushes out, sparks fly and it springs back open into a Saved pill. It suits download links for apps, PDFs and music.
how: Hover to see a shine sweep across; press Download.
The pill squashes, then shrinks into a circle while the ring spins into place around it.
The ring fills with a glowing head on its front edge, and the percent counts up in the middle.
At 100% the circle fills and pops, a ripple and sparks burst out, a tick draws, then it springs open into Saved and resets.
